leadText:
Captain Cyllene (Japanese: シマボシ Shimaboshi) is the leader of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps.

She bears a striking resemblance to Cyrus, the leader of Team Galactic of the modern day, but the relationship between the two, if any, is unknown.
plainText:
Captain Cyllene (Japanese: シマボシ Shimaboshi) is the leader of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps.

She bears a striking resemblance to Cyrus, the leader of Team Galactic of the modern day, but the relationship between the two, if any, is unknown.

==In the core series games==
 
Cyllene first meets the player at the Wallflower, having heard Professor Laventon’s request to let the player work for the Galaxy Team’s Survey Corps in exchange for food and shelter, which she will accept if they pass a trial the next day. After Laventon, the player, and Akari/Rei finish their meal, she comes back out from inside the Wallflower and gives the player shelter for the night, although she warns that failure to pass the trial will cause them to be expelled from the village.

As the Survey Corps' captain, her primary purpose is to oversee the progress of the player's Pokédex and increase their rank whenever enough research points have been obtained.

==In the TCG==
 
 
Cyllene was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese subset and the English expansion, with artwork by nagimiso. It was also released as a and in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by the same artist. It allows the player to flip two coins, then put a card up from their discard pile on top of their deck for each heads flipped.
 

==Trivia==
Cyllene is shown to have a fear of bugs, as she screams when a wanders into her office.
After defeating Zisu's fourth team in Path of Tenacity, she mentions that Cyllene was one of the best swordswomen in Hoenn. 
Cyllene coined the term massive mass outbreak.
